notes: Camera shared GPIO reference counting and DP virtual modes are part of the kernel base.
ReSukiSU is pinned to the version embedded in upstream real-38's successful artifact.
Other formerly mutable dependencies use their latest commit preceding that build; the historic run did not prove their exact revisions.
Imported changes are committed directly, without external driver symlinks or build-time patches.
The OnePlus-specific BBG ABL/EFISP flashing exception is excluded; standard BBG partition protection is retained.
